description: Deterministic canonical contract and regression fixture for #398 / DT-14 End-to-End Digital Thread. Defines canonical identities, module definitions, parameters, transitions and invariants across QuoteLine -> FurnitureInstance -> Design -> SketchUp -> WorkingCopy -> DesignRevision -> Reconciliation -> Requote -> Approval -> ProductionRelease.

scenarioA_quoteFirst.description: Quote has 1-door cabinet + 3-drawer unit; Design created from Q1; drawer modified 600->650; R1 published; reconciled; requoted Q2; R1 approved and released; R2 published afterwards leaving release pinned to R1

scenarioB_quantityMultiple.description: QuoteLine quantity=3 produces 3 distinct FIs; placing only 2 in design marks the 3rd as quoted_not_modeled

scenarioC_designFirst.description: Catalog insertion creates FI-D directly in project; reconciliation against initial quote reports modeled_not_quoted; explicit requote incorporates FI-D preserving same identity

scenarioD_duplicateIdentity.description: Duplicating a managed root produces a copy with origin=duplicate; unresolved duplicate fails publish preflight closed

scenarioE_semanticScope.description: Unmanaged entities (walls, plants, lights, decor) are excluded from publication manifest, DesignRevisionItems, and production fingerprint

scenarioF_staleConcurrency.description: Publishing against a stale base revision returns 409 conflict and creates no revision or orphaned artifacts

scenarioG_releaseDurability.description: ProductionRelease remains pinned to approved R3 and fingerprint F3 even after R4 and R5 are published

invariantsNumbering: The IDs below are CONTRACT-FIXTURE-LOCAL (C1..C9). They intentionally do NOT reuse the canonical Digital Thread invariant numbering I1..I14, whose authority is docs/architecture/project-design-digital-thread.md §3 (e.g. C5 here is NOT spec I5).

invariants.C3: No invented local FurnitureInstance IDs without backend authority
invariants.C4: Exact QuoteRevision and DesignRevision IDs are strictly required for reconciliation
invariants.C5: Accepted QuoteRevision and published DesignRevision are immutable
invariants.C6: ProductionRelease is immutable and pinned to exact revisions + fingerprint
invariants.C7: Publishing R(N+1) never mutates or retargets existing ProductionRelease
invariants.C8: Cross-project linking is strictly rejected at database and service boundary
invariants.C9: Multi-tenant RLS prevents foreign organizations from mutating Digital Thread state
